summary: Nathaniel DeWitt Garson works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at the University of Virginia under doctoral supervisor Jeffrey Hopkins and also studied under traditional teacher Khenpo Namdrol.

Nathaniel Wallich (1786–1854) earned an M.D. from Aberdeen and an honorary doctorate from Copenhagen. He served as Superintendent of The Asiatic Society's museum (1814), Superintendent of the Indian Botanic Garden (1817–1846), and Vice-President of the Linnean Society of London (~1849–1854).

Nathmal Tatia (1923–2003) was a scholar of Indology, philosophy, and religious studies. He earned a Doctor of Literature from the University of Calcutta under Satkari Mookerjee, studied under Sukhlal Sanghvi, and served as Director of the Jain Vishva Bharati Institute (attested 1982–1990).
Navaneethakrishnan S is an Indologist who earned an MPhil from the University of Sri Lanka. In 2021, he held an appointment as Senior Lecturer at the University of Jaffna.
Navina Lamminger specializes in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. She completed her PhD at the University of Munich under the supervision of Franz-Karl Ehrhard.

Nawang Tsering Shakspo (born 1948) works in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He completed his doctoral studies under Lal Mani Joshi and served as a Lecturer at the Central Institute of Buddhist Studies (attested 1985).
Nazir Ahmad Dehlvi (1831–1912) was an Indology scholar who studied under Mamluk Ali Nanautawi at the University of Delhi (~1845–1853). He later taught Ghulam Yazdani.
Neal Donner works in Buddhist studies and sinology. He studied at the University of British Columbia under Leon Hurvitz (attested 1976).
Neelima Mundayar works in religious studies and Indology. She is a PhD student at the University of Edinburgh under the doctoral supervision of Wilfried Swenden (attested 2026).

Nenghai Shi (1886–1967) studied at Peking University under Kecheng Zhang, and later under Foyuan, Guanyi, Khangsar Dorje Chang, and Khangsar Rinpoche. He founded the Shaocheng Society of Buddhist Studies (1917) and served as vice-president of the Buddhist Association of China (1953–1966).

Nepal Das is a scholar of Indology and philosophy. He earned degrees from RKMVERI (2011–2016) and an MPhil and PhD from National Sanskrit University (2016–2022), becoming an Assistant Professor at Central Sanskrit University in 2020.
Newton Mohun Dutt was an Indology scholar who served as Curator of Libraries for Baroda State and at the Central Library of Vadodara (~1914–1932).
Ng-Fung Yuen works in Buddhist studies and religious studies. He earned a PhD from the University of the West under the supervision of Kottegoda S. Warnasuriya (attested 2009).
Ngakchang Gönpo Tsé Ten studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and Dudjom Rinpoche.

Ngan-che Chan holds degrees from HKU (PhD, attested 2007), Leeds (MSc, 2009–2010), and CUHK (MPhil, 2012–2014), having studied under Jing Yin and K. L. Dhammajoti. He became Assistant Professor at CUHK in 2023.
Ngawang Jorden works in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He held a post at Sakya College and served as director of the International Buddhist Academy.
Ngawang Lek Shé Gyatso studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Dodrupchen Rinpoche, and Trulshik Rinpoche.

Ngawang Nyima was a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under the 13th Dalai Lama, the 14th Dalai Lama, and Trijang Rinpoche, and taught Dezhung Rinpoche Kunga Tenpai Nyima, Thubten Jigme Norbu, and Dagpo Rinpoche.
Ngawang Sherpa specializes in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He earned a PhD in Buddhist studies from Florida State University in 2022 and held an appointment in religion there in 2022.

Ngorpa Pönlob Lo Ter Wangpo studied under Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye, Shechen Gyaltsab, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso. He taught Shenphen Nangwa and Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö.
